# CDD Affine Group 99 Live Diff

This report compares normal-mode READ BUFFER id=01/02 offset=0x070000 captures after changing LD5M CDD stream 2 affine group 99 from decoded byte 0x0a to 0x0b, then restoring stock. The flash restore was verified byte-for-byte after a hardware cold boot.

The normal READ BUFFER work-window is a rotating tile surface. This
report only compares 0x40-byte chunks that are stable inside each state.
